title: A Systematic Mapping on Software Fairness: Focus, Trends and Industrial Context
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable as the paper does not analyze religion.
findings: This paper is a systematic mapping study on software fairness, focusing on aspects like bias in datasets related to finance and socioeconomic status. It does not contain any analysis or findings related to religion or faith.
